known.summary: a status-label change cannot trigger the settle-wait refusal without changing plan.mjs, which Do not touch forbids: statusFromIssue derives a closed issue's status from stateReason and ignores labels, so reopenPlan still sees finished and the same close and reopens, while the test expects exit 1 and no write
